name: Bypass Play Store install check (IPTV)

name: Unlock Pro (IPTV)

name: Change ChMate package name

name: Migrate ChMate data with Shizuku

name: Save ChMate crash logs

description: Injects the local Stockfish chess engine into Chess.com for real-time analysis, best-move arrows, and customizable settings.
name: Stockfish Engine Integration

description: Adds download quality choices, saves Photo Mode images directly from their source URLs, keeps a video's sound as its own audio file, and saves a profile picture or a story from a long press.
name: Advanced downloads

description: Ignores the creator's Duet and Stitch setting so the entries appear for videos that closed them. Everything else the app checks still applies: a photo post, a private video or one with music it may not reuse is still refused, and whether the upload is accepted is the server's decision, not the app's. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Allow Duet and Stitch

description: Removes secure window flags and disables the Circle to Search block. Off by default; restart after changing.
name: Allow screenshots and Circle to Search

description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.
name: Always show publish date

description: Replaces TikTok's dark background palette with black or a chosen color. The light theme keeps its colors. Choose this patch to enable it. It is the one patch that rewrites resources, so patching with it on needs the memory limit raised to 768 MB.
name: AMOLED dark theme

options.description: An opaque hex color. Black turns off OLED pixels on the main dark surfaces.
options.title: Dark background color

description: Keeps TikTok's automatic advance enabled while preserving its pause, dialog and gesture checks, and shows TikTok's own Auto scroll action in the video panel for accounts outside its rollout.
name: Automatic video advance

description: Adds a block button to the video player that blocks the account that posted the current video in one tap, with an undo action. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Block author button

description: Shows TikTok's own comment sort sheet on every post, with its hot, newest, media and creator options, instead of the cut-down row an account outside the rollout is given. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Comment sort controls

description: Hides comments that contain chosen words or come from chosen accounts, turns the thumbs down on each comment into a block button, hides comments made of an image or a sticker rather than words, and adds a box above the comments that narrows them by what they say or who said it. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Comment tools

description: Adds optional second-tap protection to the feed Follow button and like heart. A red ring marks the armed button.
name: Confirm feed interactions

description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.
name: Copy comments without username

description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.
name: Custom offline videos limit

description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local TikTok crash capture.
name: Diagnostic tools

description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.
name: Disable login requirement

description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.
name: Disable long-press quick share

description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.
name: Disable long-press repost

description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.
name: Disable screen capture detection

description: Adds an App behavior toggle that stops ByteDance AppLog analytics, AppsFlyer attribution, explicit Firebase screen reports and crash reporting. TikTok's own diagnostics go quiet with them. Off by default. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Disable telemetry

description: Lets double taps do nothing or open the current video's comments.
name: Double-tap controls

description: Adds watermark-free downloads, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.
name: Downloads

description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.
name: Enable Live search

description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.
name: Enable non-personalized search

description: Turns on TikTok's own voice comment recording and publishing entry points for accounts that do not have them. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Enable voice comments

description: Adds an option to show the full Activity and New followers lists instead of collapsing them behind a View all button. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Expand activity list

description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.
name: Feature Gate Lab

description: Records feature gate reads while you use TikTok and compares them with their previous values.
name: Feature Gate Recorder

description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, LIVE replays, stories, photo posts, paid partnerships, AI labelled videos, verified accounts, series, playlists, the playlist bar, the floating event badge and inserted cards. Videos can also be filtered by your own caption words, creator handles or patterns, sound names, length, the country they were posted from and their view, like, comment, favourite and share counts. Sponsored cards are dropped from the profile video viewer, the search grids and the Friends tab as well as the feed. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Feed filter

description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.
name: Feed tab navigation

description: Puts the whole of a vertical video on screen instead of cropping it to the window. On a 9:16 phone nothing changes, because the video already fills it. On a Fold opened up, a squarer phone or a split view the sides or the ends stop being cut off. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Fit video to the screen

description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.
name: Fix Google login

description: Shows comments beside the video on windows wider than a configurable threshold. Off by default.
name: Foldable split comment view

description: Reads what the server said about a follow. A follow TikTok turns down comes back looking like a success, so this reports the refusal and its reason once per session and, with diagnostic logging on, writes the whole exchange to the report. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Follow diagnostics

description: Adds an option to stop TikTok reporting that you viewed a story or a profile or that you are typing. Online status is unchanged. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Ghost mode

description: Keeps a local record of the videos you have watched and drops them from later feed pages. The record never leaves the device and can be cleared from settings. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide already seen videos

description: Hides TikTok's risk control CAPTCHA dialog, which the browsing CAPTCHA patch does not cover. Answers the Hide CAPTCHA popups setting, never touches SMS or two factor verification, and never hides a check the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost. Off by default. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide BdTuring CAPTCHA popups

description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs. Login and account verification stay visible, and so does any puzzle the server raised over a follow, like, comment or repost, because hiding one of those makes the action fail with no message.
name: Hide CAPTCHA popups

description: Stops the brand animation that plays over the comment sheet when a comment matches an advertiser's trigger word or emoji. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide comment popup ads

description: Adds an option to play videos TikTok has classified without the warning overlay asking to be tapped through first. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide content warnings

description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.
name: Hide feed follow button

description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds. Shares its switch with the Live entrance option of Hide video overlays, and stops the button before it is built rather than hiding it once it is on screen.
name: Hide feed LIVE button

description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.
name: Hide feed save button

description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.
name: Hide feed search button

description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.
name: Hide floating promotions

description: Adds a switch for each row and header control on the Inbox tab, so message requests, TikTok Tako, TikTok Shop, the stories tray and the rest can be hidden individually. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide inbox items

description: Stops the stories tray at the top of the Inbox from being built. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide inbox stories

description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.
name: Hide quick comment reactions

description: Hides the suggested searches TikTok offers on the search page before you type, and stops the page asking for them. Your own search history is left alone. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide search suggestions

description: Stops the suggested accounts list from being built on the Activity, New followers and Inbox pages. Shares its switch with Hide inbox items. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide suggested accounts

description: Hides the visual search prompt TikTok lays over videos, the Live entrance in the top left corner, the caption, the music line, the action column on the right, the survey cards and the status bar, each with its own switch. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Hide video overlays

description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.
name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock

description: Lets a long press on a video keep TikTok's own action, do nothing, open the video's comments, save the original sound, or copy the link to the video or its sound, and can turn a press on the left or right third of the screen into a jump back or forward. Brings Double-tap controls with it, which supplies the comment control. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Long-press controls

description: Adds a button beside the block control to tell TikTok you aren't interested in the current video. Off by default.
name: Not interested button

description: Adds a switch for the notification saying somebody new followed you, and one for message streaks, neither of which TikTok lets you turn off. The follower switch drops the notification before Android is asked to post it, so nothing else in the drawer is affected. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Notification controls

description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.
name: Open external links directly

description: Selects the lowest, highest or a target video quality for playback, adaptive streams included. A second choice caps quality on mobile data and only ever lowers it. Download quality has its own setting. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Playback quality

description: Remembers playback speed or applies a default to each new video, with custom menu choices up to 3x.
name: Playback speed

description: Matches locale, timezone and native region getters to the SIM preset, with a separate experimental store-region switch.
name: Region spoof

description: Remembers clear display between videos, or enters it automatically after a chosen delay.
name: Remember clear display

description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.
name: Resume videos after scrolling

description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared, and can put a host of your choosing in place of tiktok.com.
name: Sanitize sharing links

description: Adds the Hushfeed settings screen to TikTok. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Settings

description: Asks for a second tap before a video is sent to a friend from the share sheet, and hides chosen people or share options, or the whole Send to row. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Share sheet tools

description: Adds an option to show the country a video was posted from next to the creator's name on the feed. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Show author region

description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.
name: Show seekbar

description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.
name: Show seekbar thumbnail

description: Spoofs SIM country and operator information retrieved by TikTok, with country presets for easier setup.
name: SIM spoof

description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.
name: Stop video looping

description: Saves subtitle files beside downloaded videos and adds caption size, background, and clear-display options.
name: Subtitle tools

description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.
name: Translate comments

description: Stops TikTok asking the screen to run slower than it can, which it does by asking for the frame rate of the video it is playing. On a 90 or 120 Hz phone that ask takes the whole app down to that rate, scrolling included. A request that is not slower than the screen is left alone. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.
name: Uncap the refresh rate

description: Kizu Twitch enhancements: third-party emotes, live ad blocking, appearance controls, deleted-message display, privacy controls, native Video Stats and single-tap Reload Stream, PurpleTV-style landscape brightness/volume gestures with swipe-to-portrait collapse prevention, Hide Stories, Go Ad-Free hiding, and patched-app compatibility.
name: Twitch Enhancement

description: Replaces native Oculus face/eye permission checks with the Android XR permission names used by Galaxy XR, including the verified Steam Link 5001712 layout.
name: Android XR native permission names

description: Legacy overlay-permission fallback retained for older Steam Link builds. Adds SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW and the compositor signal window.
name: Appear on top (legacy)

description: Renames the manifest package and Steam Link's internal VR-launch component so the patched app can coexist with the original installation.
name: Change package name

options.description: Accepts either a full Java package name (for example, com.valvesoftware.steamlinkvr.galaxyxr) or a display suffix (for example, Galaxy XR). Suffix input appends to app name and generates a package suffix automatically.
options.title: Package name

description: Derives current controller linear and angular velocity from grip/aim pose history and can reduce VRLink's stock four controller pose sends per display frame.
name: Controller velocity fix

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+32 (int64 ns = value×1e6). Falls back to runtime velocity when pose samples are farther apart. Allowed range: 5 to 100 ms.
options.title: Maximum sample gap (ms)

options.description: libvrlink_scene.so QSVLClient::OnTopOfFrame: selects four, two, or one evenly phased controller pose sends per display frame. Actual send Hz equals display Hz multiplied by 4, 2, or 1. Stock preserves Valve behavior.
options.title: Controller pose-send cadence

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+48 (float32 EMA weight). 0 = no smoothing, minimum lag; higher values reduce jitter. Allowed range: 0.0 to 0.9.
options.title: Derived velocity smoothing

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+40 (float32 m/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived linear speed. Allowed range: 1 to 50 m/s.
options.title: Maximum linear speed (m/s)

options.description: libgxr_controller_velocity.so config+44 (float32 rad/s). Falls back to runtime velocity above this derived angular speed. Allowed range: 1 to 100 rad/s.
options.title: Maximum angular speed (rad/s)

description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions.
name: Device identity

options.description: Recommended uses Meta Quest Pro on exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244 (including 5001712), and Galaxy XR otherwise. Explicit profiles override that choice. Native-XR routing and verified legacy payloads are preserved.
options.title: HMD identity

description: Bypasses the two verified capability gates in QSVLDeviceHmd::Init for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.
name: Force HMD initialization gates

description: Bypasses the verified permission-state gate in XrSceneLobby for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, and 5002313.
name: Force lobby permission-state gate
